# Problem setup:

## Points

- A(0.0000, 3.5000)
- B(-3.0000, -1.5000)
- C(3.0000, -1.5000)
- D(0.0000, -1.5000)

## Assumptions:

[C0] : AC = AB
[C1] : CD = BD

## Numerical checks

[N0] : A ≠ B
[N1] : A ≠ C
[N2] : A ≠ D
[N3] : B ≠ D
[N4] : C ≠ D
[N5] : A, B, D are not collinear
[N6] : ▲ABD has the same orientation as ▲ADC


# Goals

∠(AB,AD) = ∠(AD,AC) : Proved [2]


# Proof:

000. | AC = AB [C0], AD = AD [T0], CD = BD [C1], A ≠ B [N0], A ≠ C [N1], A ≠ D [N2], B ≠ D [N3], C ≠ D [N4], A, B, D are not collinear [N5], ▲ABD has the same orientation as ▲ADC [N6] =(r65 SSS Congruence of triangles (Reverse))> ▲ABD ≡ ▲ACD [0]
001. | ▲ABD ≡ ▲ACD [0] =(r78 Properties of congruent triangles (Reverse))> ▲ABD ≅ ▲ACD [1]
002. | A ≠ B [N0], A ≠ C [N1], A ≠ D [N2], B ≠ D [N3], C ≠ D [N4], ▲ABD ≅ ▲ACD [1] =(r53 Properties of similar triangles (Reverse))> ∠(AB,AD) = ∠(AD,AC) [2]


# Appendix: AR deductions:

End of proof.
